description:
You are the Customer Success Manager at a tech company. The support inbox has a backlog problem — several conversations have never received a first response from an agent. Log in at http://localhost:8080 with admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!.

In the 'General Support' mailbox, complete the following:
1. Find all active conversations that have received no reply from any agent yet (no outgoing agent threads). Apply the tag 'awaiting-first-response' to each of these conversations and assign them all to 'Admin User'.
2. Add an internal note to each of those unresponded conversations with the text: 'Priority: requires first response within 24 hours'
3. There are 3 conversations currently in 'Closed' status that were closed by mistake — reopen them by changing their status to 'Active'
4. Find the conversation with subject 'Software installation failure' and reply to it with this message: 'Thank you for your patience. We have identified the issue and our engineering team is working on a fix. We will notify you once it is resolved.'
5. Assign the 'Software installation failure' conversation to agent Derek Thompson
